summary: F2-A · Safety Topic Library MVP — full backend + frontend verification PASSED. 10/10 pytest cases (RBAC, validation, PDF magic-bytes + page count). Frontend: library root renders for safety-scoped users, 3 severity chips, 22 domain chips (verified `all` + `concrete`), search + filter combinations + empty-state, multi-select + Generate-PDF dialog with 3 language radios, PDF blob download with %PDF magic bytes. SafetyHub tile navigates to library. Severity boundary holds (zero leaks on /meetings/new). Unauth visit to /safety-portal/library redirects to /safety-portal/login.
action_items: (Cosmetic, optional) Both 'Select all visible' button and per-row checkbox share the 'select-' testid prefix. Row checkbox is 'select-{key}', the button is 'select-all-visible'. Tests using `[data-testid^=select-]` will match both; consider renaming the button to 'library-select-all' or the row checkboxes to 'row-select-{key}' for unambiguous selectors. Not blocking — code works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth gate in /app/backend/routes/safety_topic_library.py is correctly wired to make_require_safety_or_admin via factory pattern — verified 401 on no/bad token, 200 on valid safety/admin.
Validation logic is sound: explicit 400s for empty topics, invalid language, and missing ES content when languages='both' or 'es'. Error messages include the offending topic keys.
PDF rendering uses BaseDocTemplate + Frame + onPage callback for footer/eyebrow rule; one-topic-per-page layout works for EN-only, ES-only, and Both (EN+ES = 2 pages confirmed).

Frontend SafetyTopicLibrary.jsx correctly attaches X-Safety-Token (preferred) or falls back to X-Admin-Token from local storage, uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, and handles the PDF blob download with URL.createObjectURL + cleanup. State management is clean (Set-based selection, useMemo for filtered/counts).

Severity-rendering boundary is held: severity is ONLY visible on /safety-portal/library page (PDF + on-screen badge). Zero leak detected on /meetings/new (verified via body text scan for fatal_risk / serious_injury / lost_time + dash variants).
